name: container-updater
description: Panel autoalojado para vigilar y actualizar las imagenes Docker de un NAS Synology

scripts.build: npm run build -w @cu/shared && npm run build -w @cu/server && npm run build -w @cu/web
scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @cu/server & npm run dev -w @cu/web
scripts.docker:push: docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 --build-arg APP_VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") -t ghcr.io/mateof/container-updater:$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") --push .
